description: Computes one or more experimental (sample) variograms from a points or downhole intervals source object and writes them to a new experimental variogram object. A single call can mix omnidirectional, directional (azimuth/dip tolerance cone with optional bandwidth/bandheight) and downhole variograms, each with its own lag definition.

SourceAllOfFilter.description: A composite filter that passes locations satisfying ALL child filters (AND logic).

type.description: Identifies this as an AND composite filter.
type.title: Type

filters.description: All of these filters must be satisfied (AND logic).

items.description: A filter condition or composite filter combining multiple conditions.

oneOf.description:
A leaf filter condition applied to one attribute of the filtered object.

Exactly one operator field must be provided.

- ``in``: Membership test. Provide string category names for
    ``CategoryAttribute`` objects or integers for integer-coded indices.
- ``not_in``: Exclusion test.
- ``equal``, ``not_equal``: Numeric equality/inequality.
- ``greater_than``, ``greater_than_or_equal_to``, ``less_than``,
    ``less_than_or_equal_to``: Numeric comparisons on numeric attributes.

operator.description: The filter operator. Use 'in' or 'not_in' for category/membership tests (pair with 'values'). Use 'equal', 'not_equal', 'greater_than', 'greater_than_or_equal_to', 'less_than', or 'less_than_or_equal_to' for numeric comparisons (pair with 'threshold').

values.description: Category values to match. Required when operator is 'in' or 'not_in'. Use strings for string/category-name attributes; use integers for integer-coded attributes.

parameters.description:
Task parameters for the experimental variogram computation.

Sample locations and values are read from a geoscience object (``source``). A single call
computes one or more variograms — any mix of omnidirectional, directional and downhole —
listed in ``directions``, each with its own lag definition. The results are written to a
new experimental variogram geoscience object (``target``).

source.description: The source object and attribute providing the sample locations and values.

object.description: Geoscience object containing the sample locations and values. Must be a points or downhole intervals object.
object.title: Source

attribute.description: The numeric attribute on the source object to compute the variogram on.
attribute.title: Attribute

drillhole_id.description: Optional category attribute identifying the drillhole each sample belongs to. Required for downhole variograms when the source is a points object. When the source is a downhole intervals object and this is omitted, the object's intrinsic hole identifier is used instead.
drillhole_id.title: Drillhole Id

filter.description: Optional filter to apply to the source object. This restricts the variogram computation to a subset of the samples, defined by filtering an attribute on the source object (for example a domain or region code).

where.description: A filter expression defining which locations to include. Use a FilterCondition for a single predicate, AllOfFilter for AND logic, AnyOfFilter for OR logic, or nest them to build compound predicates.

oneOf.description:
A leaf filter condition applied to one attribute of the filtered object.

Exactly one operator field must be provided.

- ``in``: Membership test. Provide string category names for
    ``CategoryAttribute`` objects or integers for integer-coded indices.
- ``not_in``: Exclusion test.
- ``equal``, ``not_equal``: Numeric equality/inequality.
- ``greater_than``, ``greater_than_or_equal_to``, ``less_than``,
    ``less_than_or_equal_to``: Numeric comparisons on numeric attributes.

operator.description: The filter operator. Use 'in' or 'not_in' for category/membership tests (pair with 'values'). Use 'equal', 'not_equal', 'greater_than', 'greater_than_or_equal_to', 'less_than', or 'less_than_or_equal_to' for numeric comparisons (pair with 'threshold').
operator.title: Operator

values.description: Category values to match. Required when operator is 'in' or 'not_in'. Use strings for string/category-name attributes; use integers for integer-coded attributes.

items.description: String category name or integer category key to match.

directions.description: One or more variogram specifications to compute in this call (at most 100). Each entry is an omnidirectional, directional or downhole variogram and produces one direction in the output object, except directional sweeps, which produce one direction per settings combination plus an optional average. A request may produce at most 100,000 curves and 20,000,000 lag bins in total.
